text: Broxley Fairkettle was a strongheart halfling representative of the Fellowship of Innkeepers in Waterdeep in the early 1490s DR.
Brevindon Margaster was a member of House Margaster in the late 15 century DR.
Broadhand was a blacksmith, owner of Broadhand's Forge and Tack, and a high-ranking member of the Church of Bane.
Brianna Moonsinger was the Great Druid of the Moonshae Isles. She was the mother of Robyn Moonsinger, her only child.
Bright Nydra () was a demigod and later an aspect of Selûne.
Bugenius (often called "Bug" by his master) was an eccentric sprite mage of the mid–14 century DR.
Brieme was a noviere eladrin who served as an advisor to the triton king Mirentos. She kept her identity a secret, always appearing in triton form when in the company of others.
Brilla Silvershield was a patriar of the noble Silvershield family who lived in their familial estate in the mid–14 century DR.
Bulad, also called Bulad the Steelmaker, was a renowned weaponsmith inhabiting in Hiyal around 1367 DR.

Brialer Erkowe was a former adventurer who found a new life as an innkeeper in the city of Myth Drannor. He was the owner and proprietor of the Owl Towers inn, found in the Myth Drannan district of Dlabraddath.
Bressana Wildmaster was an elf of New Sharandar who lived in the fey settlement during the late 15 century of the Faerûnian calendar.
Bryn Goldtooth was a halfling shopkeeper of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Brynn Osstra was a farmer that lived in Nightstone with his family during the late 15 century DR.
Broland Osstra was a young farmer that lived in Nightstone during the late 15 century DR.
Brieth Tanalar was a ex-Purple Dragon, horse breeder and businessman of Tilverton in the 1350s–1360s.
Brosha Manx was a half-elf apothecary and proprietor of the Loudwater Apothecary in Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the late 15 century DR.
Brion was a young thief that served in the Company of Dawn mercenary company during the mid–14 century DR.
Briartan was a High druid from the Circle of Leth charged with the protection of the Mucklestones in the Forest of Lethyr.
Brynna was a young woman from the Western Heartlands who joined the Cult of the Absolute during the late 15 century DR.

Bui the Hog was a gambler. In , she played Three-Dragon Ante against Warian Datharathi, Yasha, and Shem somewhere north of Cathyr in Dambrath, but went too deep into debt to continue throughout the evening. Before Warian was able to claim the accumulated pot, she taunted him and then attacked him with a broken chair leg; after Yasha restrained him, he discovered the powers of his plangent arm. He freed himself from Yasha and struck Bui down. To the gambler's judgement, Bui may have had orcish blood or been a northern berserker.
Brother Shad was a priest of Chauntea inhabiting Immilmar in Rashemen in the .
Bristlebeard was a dire boar inhabiting the Ashenwood in Rashemen during the late 14 century DR.
Loremaster Most High Brevek Faenor was an ambitious worshiper of Oghma who tended the Unrolling Scroll shrine in Baldur's Gate.

The Bright Star was a lovelorn character from a myth in Sildëyuir, an elder elf whose love for the Far Traveler was parted by events for centuries, but in the end they found the way back to each other. A constellation in Sildëyuir's sky was named after her. Nangulis called Kiril Duskmourn, his love, by the pet name of Bright Star.
Brindra Arrose was a pirate who was a loyal crewmember of the Kissing Shark helmed by Blackfingers Ralingor in the Utter East in the late 14 century DR.

Briez was a resident of Phlan that worked as a server at Madame Freona's Tea Kettle during the late 15 century DR. She was one of five daughter's the restaurant's owner and proprietress, Madame Freona.
Brest was a warrior-priest of Bane who lived during the 8 century DR.
Budd was a young dimwitted korobokuru adventurer from the Malatran Plateau in Kara-Tur, active in the late 14 century DR.
Bresnoss Artemel was the patriarch of the Waterdhavian noble house Artemel during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bryn Kernwyld was a druid of Chauntea who inhabited the Moonshae Isles. She was known for creating several spells unique to her faith.
Bristar Risingsun was a half-elf wizard inhabiting the city of Ammathtar in northeast Dambrath during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Brunzarra Hethcanter was a member of the influential Hethcanter family and the second Lady of Graces in service of the Court of King Foril Obarskyr I of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Broargarg was a white-haired bugbear belonging to the Frosthunger Horde of the Frozenfar in the late 15 century DR.
Brunga was the saru child responsible for a wasting disease her village became afflicted with in the late 14 century DR.
Buirholdan Skordar was a retired warrior and mason inhabiting Waterdeep, the City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Buckaladar Flagonsrich, or Buck Flagonsrich, was the Guildmaster of the Distillers' Guild in Purskul of Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Buldos Durinbold was a noble inhabiting Waterdeep, City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Brohn was a member of the Targos Guard, active in the early 14 century DR.
Brus was a commoner child messenger and a nephew of the Shadow Thief named Gaelan Bayle from Athkatla in the late 14 century DR.

Broonella Blacknee was a halfling woman who operated the Blacknee's Halfhappenstance inn of Halfhap alongside her husband Buzzrip Blacknee in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. They were assisted by their adult children Breena Blacknee, Billyup Blacknee, and Boldric Blacknee.
Brossan was a member of the Cult of the Dragon living as a hermit in the mid-14 century DR.
Bubba was a saru warrior, adopted and raised by the reformed cannibal Kukalatu tribe of the Malatran Plateau in the late 14 century DR.
High Moonmistress Brima Chintamn was the Selûnite high priest of Bright Lady's Tower in Chancelgaunt during the 8 century DR.
Brigganocks were a species of tiny fey whose spirits manifested outside of their bodies.
Brianna Tarvison was an adventurer and member of the She-Wolves mercenaries in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Briennelle Zaharina, or Brie-Zara and later Breezy for short, was the half-drow daughter of Drizzt Do'Urden and Catti-brie born in the late 15 century DR.
Brikhalna Ipprszhen, also known as Dutch, was an illithid gambler, businessman, restauranteur, and criminal enterpriser of the Underdark in the 14 century DR.
Brianna was a barmaid who worked in the Cracked Tankard tavern in the Crow's End district of Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late-14 century DR.
Brinna Brightsong was a halfling bard who lived and performed in Triel during the late 15 century DR.
King Brinnaq Torlath I "the Shining" was an Amnian monarch of the Torlath dynasty who greatly expanded the realm.
King Brinnaq Torlath II was an Amnian monarch of the Torlath dynasty, known as the second Wizard-King of Amn.
High Marshal Brenth Stoutshield was a halfling crusader who came to found and lead the Citadel of the Banner Raised Anew in Amn in the 14 century DR.
Brent Crivens was one of the inhabitants of Reithwin, the town that once venerated Selûne in the Western Heartlands, sometime before the late 14 century DR.
Brigid was the wife of Cormac, a gentleman of means from the Rivington district of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Brick was a gnomish highsunfeat dish from the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast.
Brevin was a gnome who lived in Baldur's Gate during the late 15 century DR.
Brunnt Hallow was a reserved man from Reithwin, once a Selûnite town in the Western Heartlands, sometime before the late 14 century DR.
Bruck was a Netherese shipwright who worked at Gallery Steamers in Eileanar until its destruction in .
Lord Briarbroke was a nobleman from Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Brorn Roril was a retired swordcaptain of the Purple Dragons in Suzail, Cormyr, in the late 15 century DR.
Bugthimble was a grave robbing kobold in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bruha Oakhide, wife of Thatmatt Oakhide, was a commoner inhabitant of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bufort Iggles, nicknamed The Unfortunate, was an unlucky instructor who lived sometimes in or before the late 15 century DR.
Bubbles Tefoco was the oldest daughter of Oliver Tefoco, the proprietor of the Beehive Goods and Wares general store in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bretchimus was a guard at Castle Felmorel in the mid–8 century DR.
Bresmer was a seneschal of Langalos during the mid–8 century DR.
Buddug Vriss was a Sharran infiltrator from the hidden Cloister of Sombre Embrace in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bug Bludgeon was a gloom stalker ranger member of The Guild in the late 15 century DR.
Broom Boy Tigrellpie was a duergar from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bryvill Trueshot was an elf ranger in the late 14 century DR.
Brynth Carrathal was heir to the defunct Carrathal Dynasty of Callidyrr in the Moonshae Isles as of the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Brown Dort was a pirate from the nation of Klocckbarn in the Whamite Isles. Brown Dort represented Klocckbarn in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Brunwell Godber was a mysterious human Selûnite in the Wheloon Prison of Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Bulbossmos was a dretch that lurked in the middens of the Drow Stronghold in Tethyamar during the 1480s DR.
Briion Dargrant was one of the apprentices at Blackstaff Tower in the .
Brom, was a hired guard who worked at The Track in the city of Westgate in the late 14 century DR.
Brerest was one of the bandits under Helm Stoneblade in the early 3 century DR.
Broarn was the innkeeper of the Woodsedge Inn in the early 3 century DR.
Budaera was an evening-lass of Hastarl in the early 3 century DR.
Bugman was a hedge wizard noted for his particularly horrid visage.
Bruno was a half-orcish rogue student of the Neverwinter Academy in Neverwinter in the late 14 century DR.
The Brimstone Archon was a magma brute who was summoned at the Underdark Arena beneath Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.
Brinbard Meddle was a human inhabitant of Eveningstar in Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Master Brimmloch was an inhabitant of Ieirithymbul in the late 14 century.
Bronwynn was a wild elf harpist of the Redleaf Clan in the Satyrwood in the early 1300s DR.
Brun was the son of Hartkiller and the first king of Hartsvale.

Bromthar Helmbrind was the leader of the Red Shields. Through his efforts, he changed the Shields from a mercenary company to a strong merchant organization that protected Scornubel and its trade routes.

Bryntarth I was the 56th Obarskyr monarch and king of Cormyr from Year of the Stricken Star, 875 DR until his death in the Year of the Calling Shrike, 897 DR. He was born in Year of the False Smile, 852 DR, the only son and heir of King Draxius the Neverdying. His first born son Galaghard III ascended the throne after him.

Cadderly Bonaduce was a cleric of Deneir of the Edificant Library in Erlkazar and a noted adventurer of the mid-to-late 14 century DR, even achieving the status of Chosen of Deneir. He was the founder of the great library-cathedral of Spirit Soaring.
Bythnara Shobalar was a drow from House Shobalar daughter of Xandra Shobalar.

Buorstag Hlammythyl was the elected Bron (also seen as "bron", possibly a corruption of "baron") or sheriff of the town of Voonlar from about the Year of the Harp, 1355 DR, until at least the winter of the .
Burtrar Malith was a veteran bodyguard and caravan guard as well as a member of the Company of the Cloak.
Callarduran Smoothhands (), also known as the Deep Brother, was a neutral gnome deity. He was primarily venerated as the patron of the Underdark-dwelling gnome subrace, the svirfneblin.
Caledan Caldorien was once a member of the Harpers and the adventuring group known as the Fellowship of the Dreaming Dragon.
Calihye was a half-elf bounty hunter of some reputation in Vaasa in the late 14 century DR.
Buster Bracer was one of the finer armorsmiths of Clan Battlehammer in Mithral Hall in the mid–14 century DR.
Calkontor was a mage in Zhentil Keep. He became envious of the appointment of Harlshoon as first Lord of Zhentil Keep, and died in an attempt to poison him.
Calispar Delgorth was a human man and a priest of Talona in the late 1360s DR. He was a member of first the Red Brigade mercenaries and later the Vipers bandits.

Cailek Balathorp was a noble of Ravens Bluff in the Vast in the late 15 century DR. He made his living by capturing surface dwellers and delivering them to the drow who lived in the Underdark beneath the city. He went by the nickname Fetterfist while operating as a slaver.
Burgher Xarod was the original boss of the land that later became the Xiousing district in Marsember.

Bundrigo Dalastarra was a halfling man of the city of Ravens Bluff in the Vast. In the mid–14th century DR, he held the civic official position of the Regent of City Works and the heraldic office of The Ravencoat, but proved rampantly corrupt.
Byuchyuch was a goblin slave of House Do'Urden in the drow city of Menzoberranzan.
Bwimb, called the Baron of Ooze, was the first evil archomental of the Paraelemental Plane of Ooze. He was slain by Orcus-as-Tenebrous and succeeded as archomental by Bwimb II. <!--==Description==
Calla Ayetes was one of the four innkeeps of The Rapids inn in Teshwave in 1367 DR. She usually ran the bar and was resigned to her life under Zhentilar occupation.
Burak the Mongrel was a half-orc pirate on the Moonsea in 1367 DR.
Bungalow Thump was the leader of the Gutbuster Brigade, the battlerager brigade of Mithril Hall in 1484 DR.
Calagher Fey-Branche was the house patron of House Fey-Branche in Menzoberranzan in 1484 DR.
Fatima Asad was a language teacher at the Grand University of Huzuz in the Pilgrims' District of the City of Delights in 1367 DR.
The self-styled Lord Byronae Trilluach was a mercenary in Skullport.
Byubo was the Padhrasattva of Nyum within the Padhran religion. "Nyum" was a Ra-Khatian concept combining spirit, courage, and audaciousness, most similar to chutzpah.
Bupposo was a Winter Sect monk in Nakamaru in Wa in the mid–14 century DR.

King Caladorn the Wise was a ruler of the realm of Ulgarth in southeast Faerûn before the 14th century DR. King Caladorn decreed that priests could not judge a person's worldly behavior. As a result, priests could not serve as either king's justices or baron's justices in the kingdom.
Caldor Fuldren was a law enforcement officer in the town of Voonlar sometime during the term of Bron Buorstag Hlammythyl, i.e., from about 1355 DR until at least 1372 DR.
Cabrath Nelinderra () was a female drow keening spirit and a cleric of Kiaransalee. She was considered Irae T'sarran's top lieutenant in life.
Burrath was the bodyguard of Lord Olgarth Oldbridle in the late 15 century DR.
Burto Milibuck was an insane halfling thief in Yûlash in 1357 DR.

Clanlaird Burinn Rivenstone was the rock gnome ruler of the town of Zashuma in Lapaliiya in 1373 DR. Zashuma was the Lapaliiyan town devoted to Garl Glittergold and a farming community renowned for wines and olives.
Calesaer was a large wood elf in the Moonsea in the late 15 century DR.

Bullywugs were a primitive race of frog-like humanoids found throughout the bogs and marshes of Toril, the self-proclaimed lords of the swamp. Savage and self-destructive, the bullywugs regularly tampered with forces beyond their understanding, threatening the safety of others and their own brutish, noisome, and wet lives.
Cairak Redbeard was a pirate of the Nelanther Isles in the mid–14th century DR.
Cacodemon (), also called cacofiend or cacodaemon, was a conjuration spell that allowed the caster to summon a powerful demon.

Bulzo Tarhair was a master thief who lived in the city of Tyraturos, within the tharch of the same name, in Thay during the mid-14 century DR. He was a knowledgeable older rogue, who possessed at least a little bit of information about the most of the important personalities of southern Thay and had very strong opinions about the nations lack of laws.
Caesinsjach was a green dragon who lived during the Time of Dragons. She was considered by some as the mightiest of her species.
Caladra Telmaster was a town guard that lived in the settlement of Idyllglen.
Bullard Boareskyr and his brother Becil Boareskyr were dimwitted descendants of the legendary hero Boareskyr.
Magistrate Bylanna Ianulin was an official of the Amnian government who presided over the city of Athkatla during the mid–14 century DR.
Burnas Tellrot was a shady fortune-seeking adventurer from Daggerford circa 1372 DR.
Caligope was a halfling priest of Brandobaris in the 13 century DR.
Bupkin was a pony belonging to Bryn Goldtooth, a halfling shopkeeper of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Calliope was an adventuring half-elf bard and an ex-pirate, active in the late 15 century DR.
Byrt was one of the intelligent speaking wombats, similar to an awakened animal, who alongside Lugg, was a friend and companion of Artus Cimber in the mid–14 century DR.
Callaway was a hard-working older human farmer who lived in Gillian's Hill, a small hamlet along the Trade Way circa 1372 DR.
Caiphas was a noble dao inhabiting an isolated region of the Haunted Lands of interior Zakhara in 1367 DR.
Burlan Almaether was the acting High Priest of the Temple of Gond Wondermaker in Tilverton in the 1350s–1360s DR.
Burinta Shammarcron served as an Overcaptain in the city guard of Saerloon in the .
Burne Lyonsbane was warrior and a member of the Lyosnbane family that hailed from their familial keep.
The cairn of Thelgaar Ironhand was the burial site of Jarl Thelgaar Ironhand of Oman within the Moonshae Isles.
The Butcher was one of the followers of Gorgomorz, Daggerford's Devil, along with numerous orcs and tanarukka, and was the chieftain of a goblin tribe from the Delimbiyr Vale, circa 1372 DR.
Burlen was a warrior from Vaasa that traveled alongside Vala Thorsdotter and a few others on an important journey to the depths beneath Evereska in the late 14 century DR.
Burnice was a human child who grew up in the rebuilt town of Leilon in the late 15 century DR.
Cadella Thylight was a priestess of Mystra in the city of Waterdeep in the 14 century DR.
Callie Felder was the owner of the eponymous pawnshop during the mid-to-late 15 century DR.
Calabrista, or Great Lady Calabrista, was the director of a finishing school in the mid-14 century DR.

Bwimb II, called the Paraelemental Princess of Ooze, was the second evil archomental of the Paraelemental Plane of Ooze after the death of her father, Bwimb. Although she was generally considered a true archomental (in the loosest sense), she was the weakest of the group.
Cahl-Hyred was the innkeeper of the Weeping Widow Inn in the town of Targos in the early 14 century DR.

Buzzrip Blacknee was a halfling man who operated the Blacknee's Halfhappenstance inn of Halfhap alongside his wife Broonella Blacknee in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. They were assisted by their adult children Breena Blacknee, Billyup Blacknee, and Boldric Blacknee.
Cal was a tiefling resident of Elturel that became a refugee due to her peoples' exile following the Descent of the city during the late 15 century DR.
Calathalureene was a human sorceress who became the namesake of the Calathalureenteir in the Forest of Tethir.
Caldinar the Wily was a keen-witted but suspicious mage and an adventurer, active some years before the late 13 century DR.
Calaethe Hallowthorn was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.
Caethur was a moneylender of Waterdeep in the late 14 century DR.
Cadogen was a Netherese thief who worked as an Underchief at Constabulary Branch Three in Eileanar before its destruction in .
Burgaun Malsim was a human hostler at the Yawning Portal inn in Waterdeep in the late 14 century DR.
Byldrath was a middle class inhabitant of the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Bustlebury was a middle class inhabitant of the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
C. Balderk was an inhabitant of Baldur's Gate who died some years before the late 15 century DR.
Cadaver collectors were massive constructs that searched battlefields to collect the corpses of those who had fallen.
Buntter was a builder and city wall repairman from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Caladaster Daermree was a senior inhabitant of Ripplestones during the 8 century DR who had retired from wizardry.
Caldan Darkwood was a Sharran infiltrator from the hidden Cloister of Sombre Embrace in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Caerdwyn was an avid reader and a member of the Book Brigade, a book club from the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Cal Moore is an editor who previously worked at Wizards of the Coast on numerous 4th editon sourcebooks.

Callidyrr Hugh was King of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles in the late 2 century DR and the founder of the Hugh Dynasty. He was the namesake for the Kingdom of Callidyrr and for its capital, Caer Callidyrr.

Byron Cymrych II, born Merrick Cymrych, was High King of the Moonshae Isles in the late 9 century DR. He inherited a High Kingship with severely weakened authority and respect owing to the loss of the Crown of the High King by his grandfather.
Byron Cymrych I was High King of the Moonshae Isles at the turn of the 9 century DR.
Bunny Brislen was a daugther of Leepak and Dharin Brislen and sister to Blossom, all inhabitants of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Baron Callem Bormul was a Lord and a senior member of the noble patriar Bormul family of Baldur's Gate and a member of the Parliament of Peers in the late 15 century DR.
Bunch was a berbalang who served as an assistant to Vargo, the skull lord who controlled Cube 1717.
Calidove Everspring was one of the Harper commanders in charge during the Harper-Reithwin conflict in the Western Heartlands of the late 14 century DR.
Calivar Murpeth was a Zhentarim leader in the mid-14 century DR.
Busain was a pahari inhabiting the Elemental Plane of Water in 1367 DR.
Caladar Thearyn was a magelord from Hastarl in the early 3 century DR.
Princess Callia was a member of the leShay royalty of Sarifal until her death in the mid-to-late 15 century DR.
Callie Brennan was a resident of Cormyr who lost their life in Lost Souls' Swamp.

Bynan Oakfeller, also known as Two-Axes, was a lumberjack of Silver Village. As the trading station flourished, it was renamed, and Bynan was elected to become the first mayor of Silverymoon; in the following decades, this post would also be held by both of his children.
Sir Cadril was a paladin and Knight of the Order of the Radiant Heart, who resided in the Temple District of Athkatla in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Caerlack Cliffgate was an inhabitant of Baldur's Gate in the 15 century DR. She was the mother of Karlach Cliffgate. She was buried in Baldur's Gate alongside Karlach's father, Pluck Cliffgate.
Burzenberg was a human commoner who resided in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Caladorn Cassalanter was a young and gallant secret Masked Lord and later Open Lord of Waterdeep, who served during the 14 and 15 centuries DR.
Casavir, also known as Katalmach was a paladin of Tyr in the mid–14 century DR who participated in the Shadow War as a companion to the Kalach-Cha.

A carrion crawler was a burrowing aberration that scavenged the dead and occasionally preyed on living creatures. Similar to a giant, toothed centipede in appearance, carrion crawlers were often accompanied by a foul odor of death, which warned others of their approach. Although their nature ultimately rested in the Far Realm, it was thought by many, and indeed was possible, that carrion crawlers were created through a mad wizard's experiments.
Cassius () was the leader of and spokesman for the town of Bryn Shander in Icewind Dale and principle spokesman ("Elderman") on the Ten Towns' ruling council in the 14 century DR.

Cantoule was a male human monk and a member of the Disciples of St. Sollars the Twice-Martyred at the Monastery of the Yellow Rose in the 14th century DR. He was the head of the monastery, holding the rank of Grand Master of Flowers.
Canthus was a large moorhound which belonged to Tristan Kendrick, Prince of Corwell in the Moonshae Isles.
Canthan Doolittle was a human wizard and associated with the Citadel of Assassins.
Cassandra Thann was the powerful matriarch of the Thann clan. She was the daughter of Zelphar Arunsun, wife of Rhammas Thann, and mother of Danilo Thann.

Carmenere was an earthsoul genasi and a priestess of Selûne. She was the niece of Queen Arathane and was formerly a close friend of the rogue Riltana. Carmenere aided Demascus in destroying the Cult of the Elder Elemental Eye. She later took a post as a diplomat to High Imaskar.
Calvin Longbottle was the Regent of the Harbor of Ravens Bluff, in the year 1350 DR..

Ambassador Carrague was the honorary building inspector in Ravens Bluff for decades in the 14 century DR. He had been in the city for so long that no one remembered that his appointment was supposed to be honorary.
Canisphinxes were a variety of vicious, desert-dwelling sphinx.
Carthoun Misintle, also known as Alamondh, was a human male and the Hamayarch to the Thultyrl, or ruler, of the city of Procampur in the Vast.
Carina was a lieutenant of the Sisters of Synnoria, warriors of the Llewyrr.
Candlemas was the high steward for Lady Polaris of Delia in the Netherese Empire during the Shadowed Age.
Carrolloc Giir was the matron mother of House Druu'giir, one of the lesser houses of Menzoberranzan.

Carril Byndraeth was a Masked Lord of Waterdeep and crime lord. He was also the husband of fellow Lord Brianne Byndraeth. Having Carril married to a fellow Lord caused many troubles. The rift that was opened between the two circa 1350 DR nearly caused the Lords to split into two factions. However, Carril was killed by a black dragon seeking the return of its eye.
Ruinlord Casildar was a leader of the Zhentarim, the second-in-command of Iyachtu Xvim's Heart of the Hand and Tor Blackflame in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
Carzakh Halandir was the leader of the reformed Shadow thieves guild in Athkatla on Amn.
Cassra Brandywine was the head scribe of Mantor's Library in Phlan in 1489 DR.
Caracatl was the high priest of Tezca in Nexal in Maztica in the mid–14 century DR.
Castar of Gond was a cleric of Gond in at the Temple of Gond Wondermaker in Tilverton in 1357 DR.
Cat One-eye was a thief in Damara and a member of the Assassins Guild of the Galenas in 1359 DR.
Camden Hartwick was the king of Hartsvale in the mid-14 century DR.
Camaris Highcastle was a slave who was imprisoned by a group of illithids in the Underdark in 1368 DR.
Camber Fosrick was a fictional detective who appeared in a series of books and short stories written by Lodevin Parkar, a scribe of Cormyr, and published in Faerûn in the mid–14 century DR.
Carp Alderleaf was a young halfling boy that lived in Phandalin.
Caoimhin () was the demigod of killmoulis and a member of the Outer Circle of Queen Titania's Seelie Court. The translation of his name was "kind".
Cap'n Gyudd, who went by no other name, was a former adventurer and a shopkeeper in the city of Bral in the mid–14 century DR.
Casson Belde'ar was a child who lived in the city of Baldur's Gate in the mid–14 century DR.
Campestris were a species of sentient fungal-creatures related to myconids.
Cassiya was a prostitute in the employ of Senator Nyla of Innarlith on the Lake of Steam in the mid-1360s DR. She blew herself up in an attempt to assassinate Ivar Devorast in 1366 DR.
Sergeant Carlton was a guard who worked in the employ of the noble Seasilver family of Marsember during the late 15 century DR.
Carbury was a Netherese arcanist and prolific spell inventor who specialized in the school of illusion, particularly with phantasms.
Carcroft the Long was a historian of Faerûn who authored the seven-volume Anthropologic and Folkloric Historie of the Settled Lands.
Castigliar was a nobleman from Scardale who was the namesake of Port Castigliar in Chult.
Carkuss was a wandering human priest of Beshaba active in the late 15 century DR.
Camelon was one of the Squires of the Order of Tye, an elite organization dedicated to guarding the members of the Lords' Alliance circa 1372 DR.
Carmendine was an adventurer and follower of Deneir who founded the Zealots of the Written Word, an adventuring company that aided the Church of Deneir.
Caramip was a female rock gnome living in Gnomengarde in the late 15 century DR.
Carina Tchazzam was a member of the nobility of Waterdeep and the heiress to the Tchazzam family in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. She died before assuming control of the family.
Cantos Riverhorn was a corrupt Gem Guard Dispatcher Officer in the city of Keczulla in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Carrl was a businessman inhabiting the city of Daggerford in the Western Heartlands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Carita was one of the inhabitants of the Wandering Village who traveled Icewind Dale between the Ten Towns and Kuldahar on the Spine of the World in the early 14 century DR.

Canopic golems were large crystalline constructs created in part from the organs of living individuals. Several canopic golems were created by the mummy lord Valin Sarnaster, famed oracle of Savras from the House of the All-Seeing Orb in Tashluta.
Camaradestave was a unique magical club that was wielded as a quarterstaff by the avatar of Cyrrollalee, the halfling deity of hospitality of hospitality and friendship.
Carynara was a dryad who inhabited a remote clearing within the dangerous Fell Wood in the Spine of the World in early 14 century DR.
Caslatus Crypthound was an elven vampire hunter, active in the 14 century DR.
Caryl Nemoren was a young guardswoman from the village of West Harbor in the Mere of Dead Men circa 1374 DR.
Candril was a member of the Adventurer's Guild of the Crossroad Keep and a member of Daerred's adventuring group in the late 14 century DR.
Catanarla the Crimson Cloaked was a sorceress of Telflamm in Thesk in the mid–14 century DR.
Calliope Blingsdorf was a musician and minstrel, part of the Circus of the Last Days troupe in the late 15 century DR.
Cappa Delourese was a woman of means and a client of Sorcerous Sundries in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Duchess Callisto was the preeminent member of the ursinals and one of the Companions of Talisid, the Celestial Lion of Elysium. According to the World Tree cosmology, Callisto resided with Talisid and the other guardinal paragons, in the House of Nature.
Carvajal was a Netherese arcanist who taught magic at the Variator's Intelligentsia in Eileanar before its destruction in .
Cassie Wheynstown was an inhabitant of the city of Baldur's Gate in late 15 century DR.
Carpal was a ghoul servant of Mystic Carrion, a mummy lord who resided in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Carrionettes were malicious tiny constructs, simple toys, animated to be parasitic creatures, living off of humans, humanoid, and monstrous humanoid societies.
Carm Woodrusk was a druid of Thorngap during the late 15 century DR.
Caryn Chandler was an elder member of the extended Chandler family in the mid-1480s DR, who lived together in the Midler farmhouse near Eveningstar.
Cameron "the Wise" Cymrych was High King of the Moonshae Isles in the mid–4 century DR.
Carrig Cymrych I was High King of the Moonshae Isles in the mid-to-late 3 century DR.
Carrig Cymrych II was High King of the Moonshae Isles in the early-to-mid 5 century DR.
Carthus Cymrych was a High King of the Moonshae Isles in the early-to-mid 8 century DR.
Carrig Cymrych III was High King of the Moonshae Isles for a year at the turn of the 6 century DR.

Canot was a cardinal from the nation of Inter Mierionydd in the Whamite Isles. Canot represented Inter Mierionydd in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .

Carmon Tessler was a low-ranking priest of Chauntea who served the House of Bountiful Harvest temple dedicated to the The Golden Goddess in Ravens Bluff's Temple District of Ravens Bluff in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Caracoxa was an ettercap that laired in the basement of the Irithlium of Myth Drannor in the late 14 century DR.
Candalo Windroot was a elven druid in the late 14 century DR.
Calmishandra was a wizard residing in Stag Falls during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Cassandra was a serving wench in Stag Falls in the Vast during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Carric El'Yaranden was an elven minstrel from the island of Gwynneth who traveled the Moonshae Isles during the late 15 century DR.
